summary: Deep house: 118–124 BPM, softer four-on-the-floor, jazzy minor 7th/9th vamps, warm pads and Rhodes, round bass
body: House drums, played softer: the hats and percussion carry the groove; a little swing on the 16ths.
Harmony: minor 9ths and 11ths, i–iv or i–VII vamps; Rhodes, organ or warm pads, voicings around C4.
Bass: round and low, longer notes than house, often a soul-style line.
Mood: late night, warm; short room reverb, little distortion.

Apply: pattern/four-on-the-floor on the drums, then pattern/deep-house-i-iv on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 118–124 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one
